facts.fact: Connecting Africa says that on 24 February 2025 Senegal's President 'launched' a digital strategy called the Technological New Deal, which it says places digital technology at the heart of national development.

The article gives targets by 2034 under the strategy: over 500 recognised tech startups, 150,000 direct and 200,000 indirect digital jobs, and a 15 percent contribution of the digital economy to GDP; it states no cost.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital Economy

note: Class national on the document's description (digital technology at the heart of national development, with a digital-economy target); it does not mention the state's own administration. The plan fact's as_of is the target year. The launch by the President is recorded as adopted under the study's ladder. Universal Connectivity was launched by the President in February 2026.
